title: Growth Campaign Manager - CIS
source: https://jobs.lever.co/binance/c461e6fd-cbf6-4884-bd61-42d45ac5436e
retrieved: 2026-09-01
category: short (<200 words)
why: 80 words, a COMPLETE posting rather than a truncated one -- a
  posting cut down to fit would test truncation, not brevity. Selected
  mechanically: of 1,104 Lever-hosted postings scanned, 10 came in under 200
  words; this is the shortest of those that is in English.
declared exclusion: five shorter candidates (45-96 words, Match Group Japan)
  were excluded because their body text is Japanese. That is a VALIDITY
  constraint -- an English-language extractor cannot be measured on Japanese
  prose -- and not a screening for how the extractor might behave, which the
  selection rules forbid. Recording the exclusion so the choice is checkable.
corpus note: this is the case where the pre-declared threshold nearly failed to
  be satisfiable at all. Across 1,983 postings on 13 Greenhouse-hosted company
  boards the MINIMUM was 506 words and nothing fell under 400. Sub-200-word
  postings exist only on boards that omit the legal/benefits boilerplate most
  large employers attach. See SELECTION.md.
specificity_ratio: 0.31 (incidental -- not what this case tests)
extraction: Lever public postings API, `descriptionPlain` plus the plain text
  of each list block. Deterministic; no model in the loop, because the span
  check requires verbatim text.
---
Responsibilities
Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns.
Coordinate GTM launches across multiple functions.
Manage campaign timelines and execution.
Work closely with Community, Product, CRM, Paid and regional teams.
Localize global campaigns for the local market.
Monitor campaign performance and recommend optimizations.
Ensure consistent execution quality across all initiatives.
Requirements
3–5 years in Growth or Integrated Marketing.
Strong project management skills.
Data-driven mindset.
Experience managing integrated marketing campaigns.
Excellent stakeholder management and execution skills.
Native Russian and strong English communication skills.
